name: video_hls_example
description: Example adaptive-bitrate (HLS) playback — retold-media-ladder packages served by orator-file-service addPackageRoute (Range, playlist vs media caching, gzip bypass), played by standalone pict-section-video players and by a pict-section-fileview instance

scripts.start: npx quack build && npx quack copy && node VideoHLS-Example-Server.js
scripts.build: npx quack build && npx quack copy

author: steven

ExampleApplication.Title: Video HLS (adaptive bitrate)
ExampleApplication.Summary: Two synthetic clips (landscape 1080p and portrait 1080x1920) encoded into HLS ladders by retold-media-ladder, served by orator-file-service addPackageRoute behind global gzip, and played by standalone pict-section-video players (quality menu, data saver) and a pict-section-fileview instance (fullscreen delegation). Needs its Node host: npm run make-media, then npm start (port 9440).
